    Take the latest vegetation available

    takeLatestVegetation.Rd

    Each object in vegetationLists is the latest dataset available at time(sim), among its real per-year datasets (fireSense_dataPrepFit's lists, named year<dataYear>) and the simulated state. In a hindcast (no module simulates cohortData) the data year is the latest strictly before floor(time(sim)), the rule the fit pairs a fire year with its vegetation by (fireSenseUtils::dataYearElement(before = TRUE)): SCANFI of year Y already shows year Y's burns, so a hindcast of a SCANFI year would otherwise see the fires it predicts. In a forecast the objects no module simulates (land cover, flammability) take the data year closest to and not after floor(time(sim)), so an NRV run from 2020 uses 2020's data. An object another module simulates (simulatedObjects()) is dated time(sim), so it is always the latest and is left as it is; so is an object with no per-year list (or one whose elements are not named by year). Called at init: after that the state evolves by simulation (ageNonForest, the vegetation modules).

    takeLatestVegetation(sim)

    Arguments

    sim

    A simList.

    Value

    The simList.
